exposure: Types of breech presentation (frank, complete, footling/kneeling)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 71,943 individuals with a term, singleton gestation planning community birth in the United States at labor onset.
finding: All types of breech presentations in community birth settings were associated with increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes, including hospital transfer, NICU admission, birth injury, umbilical cord prolapse, and intrapartum/neonatal death.
mod_finding: Breech labors, compared to cephalic presentation, had significantly higher rates of intrapartum transfer and cesarean birth (OR 9.0 and OR 18.6, respectively), with 57.6% of breech births occurring vaginally.
